test_title: PYST 46: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 24 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which is the letter-cluster that DOES NOT belong to that group? (NB: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their positions in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd3c600bf09d7de25d7d22479d848ddead62c9f7437c41312681e3719e85d12d.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option (1): SXU

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/909c59a0e73ed0713ae14891476fa6f928fdff9624c48b0b6c4e043c9057aa42.png] 

**Option (2): IGL**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/63f94f288a307207dc8dcc81d3c3c3d0d0f305bac617f9d59ed9ee37dba1b552.png] 

Option (3): UZW

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f368902424db0792a74c8b00ba772a1db2411e43988e91f14ced920d106202f8.png] 

Option (4): NSP

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/70f8277ed52a6dd497bca7df7a61d009ec6c1e4e1ccee7e4c235c3db64b0fe10.png] 

The letter-cluster that DOES NOT belong to the group is: IGL**.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**
